edition.title: This weekend on Keowee + Jocassee
edition.dek: Free jazz in the alley Thursday, a James Taylor tribute in Walhalla Friday, the last Family Adventure Camp of the season — and a six-hour wild river run to close it out Sunday.

events.title: Jazz on the Alley
events.body: Seneca's Thursday-night institution — free live jazz on historic Ram Cat Alley, every week through October. The happy-hour set starts at 5:30, the main act at 6:30. Get dinner downtown and let the weekend start a day early.
events.note: Free · 6:30–9pm (happy hour 5:30) · Ram Cat Alley, downtown Seneca

events.title: Sweet Baby James — James Taylor Tribute
events.body: Bill Griese brings the Fire and Rain / You've Got a Friend / Steamroller catalog to the old Walhalla auditorium for the venue's own James Taylor night. Big-room sound, twenty minutes from the water.

events.title: Jocassee Family Adventure Camp — last one of the year
events.body: The every-Friday, all-ages tour of caves, waterfalls, and salamander hunting wraps its season with this date. It needs six people to run and seats are limited, so book ahead if you want it.
events.note: Ages 16–64 $75 · Ages 4–15 $70 · 3 & under free with a paid adult · park entry separate

events.title: Live music at both lake breweries
events.body: Keowee Brewing in Seneca and Jocassee Valley Brewing in Salem both run free live music Friday and Saturday nights, with food trucks at Jocassee Valley. Neither calendar had this week's acts posted as of publish — check the links before you head out.
events.note: Free · Fri & Sat · check each calendar for this week's lineup and set times

events.title: Wild River Adventure Tour
events.body: A six-hour push into the gorges by boat — hidden waterfalls, swimming holes, and an old-growth rainforest pocket you can't reach any other way. The operator is upfront that it's for the physically fit.

plan.title: A tribute, or the last camp of the year
plan.body: Sweet Baby James takes the WPAC stage at 7:30, or book the season's last Jocassee Family Adventure Camp before it's gone until next year. Either way, get lake time first.
plan.label: Grab Friday tickets ↗

plan.title: Jocassee before the gate line
plan.body: Devils Fork early for clear water and empty ramps, then Keowee Brewing or Jocassee Valley Brewing for whatever's on the Saturday stage.
plan.label: Plan the launch →

plan.title: Go big, or keep it slow
plan.body: Book the six-hour Wild River Adventure Tour if you want hidden waterfalls and an ancient rainforest pocket. Otherwise pick a swim beach and let the weekend end on a towel instead of a highway.
plan.label: Pick a swim spot →
